anomalies.observed: C6 is a 100u capacitor connected between /PWM1 and /PWM1_C2 (J1/J2 pin 21). The netlist contains no R10 component, although the spec calls for R9–R12 to be 0Ω jumpers selecting the PWM source pins.
anomalies.expected: R10 should be a 0Ω jumper (or resistor) between /PWM1 and /PWM1_C2, so that shorting it selects M5Stack bus pin 21 as the PWM1 source for Core2/CoreS3. A capacitor in this position is not a jumper and cannot pass the PWM signal.

anomalies.impact: For Core2/CoreS3, PWM1 cannot be connected to bus pin 21; instead the 100u capacitor AC-couples the PWM1 line to pin 21, heavily loading and distorting the PWM signal, so the channel-1 servo will not be driven correctly.
